div.div: شُخْبَةٌ A single stream of milk from the udder; (A, K;) pl. شِخَابٌ [q. v.]: (K;) or it signifies, (K,) or so ↓ شُخْبٌ , (TA,) an extended stream of milk (K, TA) when it is drawn (TA) from the udder, streaming continuously (K, TA) between the vessel and the teat. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
